<analysis>
Chronological review of this segment (after the earlier summary): the session continued overnight autonomously. Key events: archived the stopped machine-auth workspace (a301b1ce); inspected kept clones; released nightlies 3413 (after fixing the exec `ghToken` empty-if bug, eec9bd328) and 3427; ran host probes (stay-in-context, ios-caw-thread, live-sheet, workspace-retire-kept, host-checks) all passing; routed many delegate reports; made rulings (shortcut forwarding, finder scope C, open-at, specs vs product); ran a live check that found the Caw dock bug (fixed in dcecee4e2); started another nightly (bc166pa3z) which completed, but its result was not yet read when the session limit hit. No new user messages except automated rule reminders. Constraints preserved from the earlier summary.
</analysis>

<summary>
1. Primary Request and Intent:
I am the orchestrator for CawCo (repo `/home/bewinxed/cockpit`): keep the fleet healthy, ship nightlies and TestFlight builds, fix bugs at the root. Owner standing ask: "I don't want the quick fix, I want the robust fix, analyze the root issue, take a step back, and implement the fix cleanly". Automated rule repeatedly fires: "if there's an honest caveat that you are aware of and you're just reporting it to me instead of fixing it, then your work is not done yet". The owner last said "Gonna sleep finish what your can": work autonomously overnight. Earlier owner decisions (Option C live components; pins applied by the agent; real code from the first screen; HTML `page` artifact for toolchains without a plugin API) stand. The owner has not sent any new message this segment.

2. Key Technical Concepts:
- CawCo: hub + per-machine agent; delegates in workspaces (`~/.worktrees/cockpit-<id>`, bwrap/srt boundaries). Scratch fleets and Caw cannot start inside a workspace, so such specs are host checks (`host: true` on a check, optionally `machine`).
- Release: `bun ~/.worktrees/stage2-<sha>/scripts/release.ts --commit <sha> --channel nightly --output … --mac-host mac --notes <file> --publish`; install via `POST /api/binary-updates/check`, then `POST /api/agents/<id>/update` with `-H content-type: application/json -d '{}'` (obelisk d04ca118428001f1 first, wait for hub health, then Mac 271a214a5d568e4c). Stage 2 needs ≥25 GB free.
- Hub checks: `checkOnce` (a check runs once per tree; Apple gate keyed on `apps/apple` tree via `APPLE_GATE_INPUTS`); landing queue words; Apple gate = `build-both.sh ios --gate` (one warm `gate` build root, arm64); SwiftPM pins committed in `apps/apple/Package.resolved` with `-disableAutomaticPackageResolution` (swift-openapi-runtime 1.13.0 as TestFlight shipped).
- CACHEDIR.TAG signature rule retires build-output-only workspaces; `publishRuntime()` publishes runtime files concurrently (fixed the nightly dashboard cold-start rollback).
- Live components slice 1 (sheet artifact, `cawcoStage()` Vite plugin, `/@cawco/sheet`); find engine `/api/find`; open-at `?at=<docId>`; shell shortcuts forwarded from artifact iframes by `leftToShell` (page gets first claim, decided at end of dispatch; Excalidraw keeps ⌘K).
- Standing constraints: no fallbacks unless owner authorises; cutover, no shims; no unit tests; never claude-in-chrome; `sqlite3 -readonly` only against the hub DB; kill only my own PIDs; diffstat before push; don't edit owner-rules unless asked; don't ask what established practice settles; no useless tests and no repeated runs without a code change (real tests stay); never reproduce the classifier-stopped machine-auth brief content; downloaded/untrusted files go in their own empty dir and Python runs with `-I`.

3. Files and Code Sections:
- `packages/agent/src/boundary.ts` (eec9bd328): `ghToken` now begins `if [ -z "$guarded" ] && [ -z "\${GH_TOKEN:-}" ]; then` and `execScript` calls `${ghToken(id, gh)}` bare, so the generated exec is never an empty `if` on machines without `gh` (cause of stage 2 workspace rig failure "syntax error near unexpected token `fi'").
- `~/.cache/cawco-release/notes-next.md`: rewritten to contain only post-3427 items: Improved (pane switching/streaming cost, Caw first press, ⌘K inside artifacts) and Fixed (Caw dock reply, message arriving mid-load kept, switched-back panes no longer blank).
- `~/.cawco/accounts/3c788add…/claude/projects/-home-bewinxed-cockpit/memory/pending.md`: updated with stable 0.1.12 timing, iPad page-first shortcuts follow-up, TestFlight sequence, notes owed when the finder lands (open-at, tab seam fix), owner decisions raised; session-env and macOS identity checks marked passed.

4. Errors and fixes:
- Nightly at 637609a44 failed stage 2 (workspace rig): exec empty-`if` bug from the upstream guard; fixed in eec9bd328, re-release passed (3413).
- Mac update command cut off by hub restart: re-run sequentially after hub health (worked for 3427).
- ios-caw-thread first Mac run failed (no app built): ran `build-both.sh ios` first; then ALL PASS.
- Earlier-segment lesson stays: never cut tests/delegates unasked.
- Rulings I changed on a leaf's evidence: shortcut forwarding switched from task-later to synchronous end-of-dispatch (Chrome Ctrl+K search); canvas assertion changed to "canvas keeps ⌘K".

5. Problem Solving (landed on main this segment): eec9bd328 (exec fix), 637609a44 (publishRuntime), f57468076 (CACHEDIR retire), 432eb8c3d/f4e838c0d (check once), 05a4010a0 (named landing waits), 20e919275/879181db0 (gate fast), c41469bb4/3a6118c9d (Swift pins, gate once per tree), find engine 0d5aea8db, live components d9ede1e03/495066138, shortcuts ff93cc1b8, open-at f0eefc179/6da1d7fd8, tsk-16 fe73d0f7b, iOS task sheet 73c29fc91, dock fix dcecee4e2 (scheduler `join` read the fingerprint inside the effect; also hoisted `recorded`), two-pane gains 0b9b6813d. Nightlies 3413 and 3427 published and installed on obelisk and Mac. Host runs passed: stay-in-context, ios-caw-thread (iPhone+iPad), live-sheet (12 checks), workspace-retire-kept, host-checks, run-mac-checks (46 escape rows BLOCKED; 5 gh rows skipped, Mac gh not signed in). Live check of 3413 found the Caw dock bug (now fixed). Caw cost analysis: $39.96/97 turns/24h, $25.67 in 6 cold wakes; caw_model blank so `claude-opus-5-5[1m]`.

6. All user messages: No new user turns this segment. Only repeated automated rule messages: "[Rule: Leaves a known problem unfixed] if there's an honest caveat that you are aware of and you're just reporting it to me instead of fixing it, then your work is not done yet". Earlier user messages (see prior summary) still apply, ending with "Gonna sleep finish what your can".

7. Pending Tasks:
- Read the result of the just-completed nightly release (task bc166pa3z, output `/tmp/claude-1000/-home-bewinxed-cockpit/adfd0048-885e-4cb6-b3d2-bb1cfa18f319/tasks/bc166pa3z.output`; log `~/.cache/cawco-release/nightly-<sha>.log`); if published, install on obelisk then the Mac, then ONE browser live check (Caw replying in dock, ⌘K from an artifact page, a sheet; Jump if finder landed). If it passes, cut stable 0.1.12 (stable 0.1.11 lacks CawCo Agent.app bundle; needs version bump, `docs/releases/0.1.12.md`).
- Running delegates: d2c6485d (land tab seam fix 550f9d8af + stale-spec fixes + per-capture `--approve`; tab-strip gate excludes the two rest-baseline diffs), 0a6da208 (finder landing on engine, scope C, plus `FindRoutine.threadId`; then @ chips as its own item built as design A), ffa87e41 (iPad live sheets, host check on Mac), 23e62015 (MessageBody root stale-height fix + 9 review findings; then regenerate captures into `/Users/bewinxed/.cawco/tmp/23e62015/captures-v2/`, second Sonnet review, TestFlight only on SHIP), 31857ff8/579bdd72/678d8943 idle/done.
- TestFlight from the Mac (`apps/apple/scripts/testflight.py`) after review SHIP; then check the approval-crash scenario on the TestFlight build.
- Verify the live 2→1 Apple compile skip on the next Apple-touching landing.
- iPad page-first shortcut follow-up after ffa87e41; add finder/open-at and tab seam notes to the next nightly.
- Owner decisions for the morning: upstream-choice pick (artifact fb142065, 678d8943 lands after), Caw cold-wake cost (recommend 200k window `claude-opus-5-5`), Vite 5 for sheets, hang (20) and tab-strip rest baselines approval, 25 ms switch target / option (a), perf counters sysctl, compositing budget, leaf-readable item-state tool, Screen Recording grant and gh sign-in on the Mac. Do not self-approve baselines.

8. Current Work:
Cutting the nightly that carries the dock fix: a background release from main (`bc166pa3z`) completed with exit code 0 as a notification, but its output had not been read when the session limit message ("You've hit your session limit · resets 7am (Asia/Qatar)") arrived. Disk was ~49 GB free, load ~4 before the release.

9. Optional Next Step:
Read the `bc166pa3z` output to confirm the nightly published (look for "published linux-x64 binary ran: …" and `release exit=0`), then install it: `curl -X POST …/api/binary-updates/check`, update obelisk, wait for hub health, update the Mac, and launch the single browser live check leaf. In my last message I said: "Once it publishes, I'll install it on both machines and run one browser live check on the deployed dashboard: Caw replying in the dock, ⌘K from an artifact page, and a sheet."
</summary>
